Abdominal external oblique muscle.title: Abdominal external oblique muscle
Abdominal external oblique muscle.insertion: Xiphoid process,outer lip of the iliac crest, pubic crest, pubic tubercle, linea alba, inguinal ligament, anterior superior iliac spine (ASIS)
Abdominal external oblique muscle.action: Flexion of the torso and contralateral rotation of torso

Abdominal internal oblique muscle.title: Abdominal internal oblique muscle
Abdominal internal oblique muscle.origin: Inguinal ligament, iliac crest and the lumbodorsal fascia
Abdominal internal oblique muscle.insertion: Linea alba, pectineal line of pubis (via conjoint tendon) and ribs 10-12.
Abdominal internal oblique muscle.action: Bilateral: Compresses abdomen Unilateral: Ipsilateral trunk rotation
Abdominal internal oblique muscle.nerve: Thoracoabdominal nn. (T7-T11), subcostal n. (T12), iliohypogastric n. (L1) and ilioinguinal n. (L1)

Abductor digiti minimi muscle of hand.title: Abductor digiti minimi muscle of the hand
Abductor digiti minimi muscle of hand.origin: Pisiform bone, the pisohamate ligament, and the flexor retinaculum
Abductor digiti minimi muscle of hand.insertion: Base of the proximal phalanx of the 5th digit on the ulnar or medial side

Abductor pollicis brevis muscle.title: Abductor pollicis brevis muscle
Abductor pollicis brevis muscle.origin: Transverse carpal ligament, the scaphoid and trapezium
Abductor pollicis brevis muscle.insertion: Base of the proximal phalanx of thumb
Abductor pollicis brevis muscle.action: Abduction of the thumb by acting across the carpometacarpal joint and the metacarpophalangeal joint. It also assists in opposition and extension of the thumb.
Abductor pollicis brevis muscle.nerve: Recurrent branch of the median nerve

Adductor brevis muscle.title: Adductor brevis muscle
Adductor brevis muscle.origin: Anterior surface of the inferior ramus and body of the pubis
Adductor brevis muscle.insertion: The lesser trochanter and linea aspera of the femur

Adductor longus muscle.title: Adductor longus muscle
Adductor longus muscle.origin: Pubic body just below the pubic crest
Adductor longus muscle.action: Adduction of hip, flexion of hip joint

Adductor magnus muscle.title: Adductor magnus muscle
Adductor magnus muscle.insertion: Linea aspera and adductor tubercle of femur
Adductor magnus muscle.action: Adduction of hip (both portions), flexion of hip (adductor portion), extension of hip (hamstring portion)
Adductor magnus muscle.nerve: Posterior branch of obturator nerve (adductor) and sciatic nerve (hamstring)

Adductor pollicis muscle.title: Adductor pollicis muscle
Adductor pollicis muscle.origin: Transverse head: anterior body of the third metacarpal, Oblique head: bases of the second and the third metacarpals and the adjacent trapezoid and capitate bones
Adductor pollicis muscle.insertion: Medial side of the base of the proximal phalanx of the thumb and the ulnar sesamoid
Adductor pollicis muscle.action: Adducts the thumb at the carpometacarpal joint
Adductor pollicis muscle.nerve: Deep branch of the ulnar nerve (T1)
Adductor pollicis muscle.antagonist: Abductor pollicis longus muscle, abductor pollicis brevis muscle

Anconeus muscle.title: Anconeus muscle
Anconeus muscle.origin: Lateral epicondyle of the humerus proximally
Anconeus muscle.insertion: Lateral surface of the olecranon process of the ulna and the superior proximal part of the posterior ulna
Anconeus muscle.action: It is partly blended in with the triceps, which it assists in extension of the elbow. It also stabilizes the elbow during pronation and supination and pulls slack out of the elbow joint capsule during extension to prevent impingement.
Anconeus muscle.nerve: Radial nerve (C5, C6, C7, C8, and T1)
Anconeus muscle.blood: Deep brachial artery, recurrent interosseous artery

Biceps.title: Biceps
Biceps.origin: Short head: coracoid process of the scapula., Long head: supraglenoid tubercle
Biceps.insertion: Radial tuberosity and bicipital aponeurosis into deep fascia on medial part of forearm
Biceps.action: Flexes elbow, flexes and abducts shoulder, supinates radioulnar joint in the forearm

Biceps femoris muscle.title: Biceps femoris muscle
Biceps femoris muscle.origin: Tuberosity of the ischium, linea aspera, femur
Biceps femoris muscle.insertion: The head of the fibula which articulates with the back of the lateral tibial condyle
Biceps femoris muscle.action: Flexes knee joint, laterally rotates knee joint (when knee is flexed), extends hip joint (long head only)
Biceps femoris muscle.nerve: Long head: tibial nerve, short head: common fibular nerve
Biceps femoris muscle.blood: Deep femoral artery, perforating arteries; long head of biceps femoris: perforating branches from profunda femoris artery

Brachialis muscle.title: Brachialis muscle
Brachialis muscle.origin: Anterior surface of the humerus, particularly the distal half of this bone
Brachialis muscle.insertion: Coronoid process and the tuberosity of the ulna
Brachialis muscle.nerve: Musculocutaneous nerve (C5-C7) and radial nerve (C5, C6)

Brachioradialis.title: Brachioradialis
Brachioradialis.origin: Lateral supracondylar ridge of the humerus and the orbicular ligament of the radius
Brachioradialis.action: Flexion of elbow, supination and pronation of the radioulnar joint to 90°

Buccinator muscle.title: Bucinator muscle
Buccinator muscle.origin: From the alveolar processes of maxilla and mandible, buccinator crest and pterygomandibular raphe
Buccinator muscle.insertion: In the fibers of the orbicularis oris
Buccinator muscle.action: The buccinator compresses the cheeks against the teeth and is used in acts such as blowing. It is an assistant muscle of mastication (chewing) and in neonates it is used to suckle.
Buccinator muscle.nerve: Buccal branch of the facial nerve (VII cranial nerve)

Coracobrachialis muscle.title: Coracobrachialis muscle
Coracobrachialis muscle.insertion: Anteromedial surface of humerus distal to crest of lesser tubercle
Coracobrachialis muscle.action: Adducts humerus, flexes the arm at glenohumeral joint

Deltoid muscle.title: Deltoid muscle
Deltoid muscle.origin: The anterior border and upper surface of the lateral third of the clavicle, acromion, spine of the scapula
Deltoid muscle.blood: Thoracoacromial artery, anterior and posterior humeral circumflex artery

Depressor anguli oris muscle.title: Depressor anguli oris muscle
Depressor anguli oris muscle.nerve: Marginal mandibular branch of the facial nerve

Depressor labii inferioris muscle.title: Depressor labii inferioris muscle
Depressor labii inferioris muscle.origin: Oblique line of the mandible, between the symphysis and the mental foramen
Depressor labii inferioris muscle.insertion: Integument of the lower lip, orbicularis oris fibers, its fellow of the opposite side
Depressor labii inferioris muscle.nerve: Marginal mandibular branch of the facial nerve

Depressor septi nasi muscle.title: Depressor septi nasi muscle
Depressor septi nasi muscle.insertion: Nasal septum and back part of the alar part of nasalis muscle
Depressor septi nasi muscle.action: Depresses nasal septum, constricts nostril, moves apex of nose during movement of upper lip (e.g. talking)
Depressor septi nasi muscle.nerve: Buccal branch of the facial nerve

Digastric muscle.title: Digastric muscle
Digastric muscle.origin: Anterior belly - digastric fossa (mandible); posterior belly - mastoid notch of temporal bone
Digastric muscle.action: Opens the jaw when the masseter and the temporalis are relaxed.
Digastric muscle.nerve: Anterior belly - mandibular division (V3) of the trigeminal (CN V) via the mylohyoid nerve; posterior belly - facial nerve (CN VII)
Digastric muscle.blood: Anterior belly - Submental branch of facial artery; posterior belly - occipital artery

Extensor carpi radialis brevis muscle.title: Extensor carpi radialis brevis muscle
Extensor carpi radialis brevis muscle.origin: Humerus at the anterior of lateral epicondyle (common extensor tendon)
Extensor carpi radialis brevis muscle.action: Extensor and abductor of the hand at the wrist joint
Extensor carpi radialis brevis muscle.nerve: Deep branch of the radial nerve

Extensor carpi radialis longus muscle.title: Extensor carpi radialis longus muscle
Extensor carpi radialis longus muscle.action: Extensor at the wrist joint, abducts the hand at the wrist

Extensor digiti minimi muscle.title: Extensor digiti minimi muscle
Extensor digiti minimi muscle.origin: The anterior portion of the lateral epicondyle of the humerus (common extensor tendon)
Extensor digiti minimi muscle.insertion: At the extensor expansion, located at the base of the middle and distal phalanx of digit V on the dorsal side
Extensor digiti minimi muscle.action: Extends the wrist and the little finger at all joints

Extensor digitorum longus muscle.title: Extensor digitorum longus muscle
Extensor digitorum longus muscle.origin: Anterior lateral condyle of tibia, anterior shaft of fibula and superior of interosseous membrane
Extensor digitorum longus muscle.insertion: Dorsal surface; middle and distal phalanges of lateral four digits
Extensor digitorum longus muscle.action: Extension of toes and dorsiflexion of ankle
Extensor digitorum longus muscle.antagonist: Flexor digitorum longus, flexor digitorum brevis

Extensor digitorum muscle.title: Extensor digitorum muscle
Extensor digitorum muscle.insertion: Extensor expansion of middle and distal phalanges of the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, and 5th fingers
Extensor digitorum muscle.action: Extension of hand, wrist and fingers
Extensor digitorum muscle.antagonist: Flexor digitorum superficialis muscle, flexor digitorum profundus muscle

Extensor hallucis longus muscle.title: Extensor hallucis longus muscle
Extensor hallucis longus muscle.origin: Arises from the middle portion of the fibula on the anterior surface and the interosseous membrane
Extensor hallucis longus muscle.insertion: Inserts on the dorsal side of the base of the distal phalanx of the big toe
Extensor hallucis longus muscle.action: Extends (raises) the big toe and assists in dorsiflexion of the foot at the ankle. Also is a weak evertor/invertor
Extensor hallucis longus muscle.antagonist: Flexor hallucis longus, flexor hallucis brevis

Extensor indicis muscle.title: Extensor indicis muscle
Extensor indicis muscle.origin: Posterior distal third of ulna and interosseous membrane

Extensor pollicis brevis muscle.title: Extensor pollicis brevis muscle
Extensor pollicis brevis muscle.action: Extension of thumb at metacarpophalangeal joint
Extensor pollicis brevis muscle.antagonist: Flexor pollicis longus muscle, flexor pollicis brevis muscle

Extensor pollicis longus muscle.title: Extensor pollicis longus muscle
Extensor pollicis longus muscle.origin: Middle third of posterior surface of ulna, interosseous membrane
Extensor pollicis longus muscle.action: Extension of the thumb (metacarpophalangeal and interphalangeal)
Extensor pollicis longus muscle.nerve: Posterior interosseous nerve (branching from the radial nerve)
Extensor pollicis longus muscle.antagonist: Flexor pollicis longus muscle, flexor pollicis brevis muscle

External obturator muscle.title: External obturator muscle
External obturator muscle.nerve: Posterior branch of obturator nerve (third and fourth lumbar nerves)

Femur.title: Femur
Femur.articulations: Hip: acetabulum of pelvis superiorly, knee: with the tibia and patella inferiorly

Fibula.title: Fibula
Fibula.articulations: Superior and inferior tibiofibular joint, Ankle

Fibularis tertius.title: Fibularis tertius
Fibularis tertius.origin: Distal anterior surface of the fibula also the interosseous membrane
Fibularis tertius.action: Dorsiflexion and eversion of the foot

Flexor carpi radialis muscle.title: Flexor carpi radialis muscle
Flexor carpi radialis muscle.origin: Medial epicondyle of humerus (common flexor tendon)
Flexor carpi radialis muscle.insertion: Bases of second and third metacarpal bones

Flexor digiti minimi brevis muscle (hand.title: Flexor digiti minimi brevis muscle of hand
Flexor digiti minimi brevis muscle (hand.insertion: Palmar side of the base of the proximal phalanx of fifth digit

Flexor digitorum longus muscle.title: Flexor digitorum longus muscle
Flexor digitorum longus muscle.origin: Posterior surface of the body of the tibia
Flexor digitorum longus muscle.insertion: Plantar surface; base of the distal phalanges of the four lesser toes
Flexor digitorum longus muscle.action: Flexion of the four smaller digits
Flexor digitorum longus muscle.antagonist: Extensor digitorum longus, extensor digitorum brevis

Flexor digitorum profundus muscle.title: Flexor digitorum profundus muscle
Flexor digitorum profundus muscle.origin: Upper 3/4 of the anterior and medial surfaces of the body of the ulna, interosseous membrane and deep fascia of the forearm
Flexor digitorum profundus muscle.insertion: Base of the distal phalanges of the fingers
Flexor digitorum profundus muscle.action: Flex hand and both interphalangeal joints
Flexor digitorum profundus muscle.nerve: Lateral part of the muscle by median (anterior interosseous), medial (ulnar) part of the muscle by muscular branches of ulnar

Flexor digitorum superficialis muscle.title: Flexor digitorum superficialis muscle
Flexor digitorum superficialis muscle.origin: Medial epicondyle of the humerus (common flexor tendon) as well as parts of the radius and ulna
Flexor digitorum superficialis muscle.insertion: Anterior margins on the base of the middle phalanges of the four fingers
Flexor digitorum superficialis muscle.action: Flexor of fingers (primarily at proximal interphalangeal joints)

Flexor hallucis longus muscle.title: Flexor hallucis longus muscle
Flexor hallucis longus muscle.insertion: Plantar surface; base of distal phalanx of hallux
Flexor hallucis longus muscle.action: Flexes all joints of the big toe, plantar flexion of the ankle joint
Flexor hallucis longus muscle.blood: (Muscular branch of peroneal artery (peroneal branch of the posterior tibial artery)

Flexor pollicis brevis muscle.title: Flexor pollicis brevis muscle
Flexor pollicis brevis muscle.action: Flexes the thumb at the first metacarpophalangeal joint
Flexor pollicis brevis muscle.nerve: Recurrent branch of the median nerve, deep branch of ulnar nerve (medial head)

Flexor pollicis longus muscle.title: Flexor pollicis longus muscle
Flexor pollicis longus muscle.origin: The middle 1/2 of the anterior surface of the radius and adjacent to the interosseus membrane.
Flexor pollicis longus muscle.insertion: The base of the distal phalanx of the thumb
Flexor pollicis longus muscle.nerve: Anterior interosseous nerve (branch of median nerve) (C8, T1)
Flexor pollicis longus muscle.antagonist: Extensor pollicis longus muscle, extensor pollicis brevis muscle

Frontal bone.title: Frontal bone
Frontal bone.articulations: Twelve bones: the sphenoid, the ethmoid, the two parietals, the two nasals, the two maxillae, the two lacrimals, and the two zygomatics

Gastrocnemius muscle.title: Gastrocnemius muscle
Gastrocnemius muscle.origin: Proximal to articular surfaces of lateral condyle of femur and medial condyle of femur
Gastrocnemius muscle.insertion: Tendo calcaneus (Achilles tendon) into mid-posterior calcaneus
Gastrocnemius muscle.nerve: Tibial nerve from the sciatic, specifically, nerve roots S1–S2

Genioglossus.title: Genioglossus
Genioglossus.origin: Superior part of mental spine of mandible (symphysis menti)
Genioglossus.insertion: Underside of tongue and body of hyoid
Genioglossus.action: Inferior fibers protrude the tongue, middle fibers depress the tongue, and its superior fibers draw the tip back and down

Geniohyoid muscle.title: Geniohyoid muscle
Geniohyoid muscle.action: Carry hyoid bone and the tongue upward during deglutition

Gluteus maximus.title: Gluteus maximus
Gluteus maximus.origin: Gluteal surface of ilium, lumbar fascia, sacrum, sacrotuberous ligament
Gluteus maximus.insertion: Gluteal tuberosity of the femur and iliotibial tract
Gluteus maximus.action: External rotation and extension of the hip joint, supports the extended knee through the iliotibial tract, chief antigravity muscle in sitting and abduction of the hip
Gluteus maximus.nerve: Inferior gluteal nerve (L5, S1 and S2 nerve roots)
Gluteus maximus.antagonist: Iliacus, psoas major and psoas minor

Gluteus medius.title: Gluteus medius
Gluteus medius.origin: Gluteal surface of ilium, under gluteus maximus, Aponeurosis glutea
Gluteus medius.action: Abduction of the hip; preventing adduction of the hip. Medial/internal rotation and flexion of the hip (anterior fibers). Extension and lateral/external rotation of the hip (posterior fibers)
Gluteus medius.nerve: Superior gluteal nerve (L4, L5, S1 nerve roots)

Gluteus minimus.title: Gluteus minimus
Gluteus minimus.origin: From area in between the anterior gluteal line and inferior gluteal line of gluteal surface ilium, under gluteus medius.
Gluteus minimus.action: Works in concert with gluteus medius: abduction of the hip; preventing adduction of the hip. Medial rotation of thigh.
Gluteus minimus.nerve: Superior gluteal nerve (L4, L5, S1 nerve roots)

Gracilis muscle.title: Gracilis muscle
Gracilis muscle.action: Flexes, medially rotates, and adducts the hip

Hamate bone.title: Hamate bone
Hamate bone.articulations: Articulates with five bones:, the lunate proximally, the fourth and fifth metacarpals distally, the triquetrum medially, the capitate laterally

Iliacus muscle.title: Iliacus muscle
Iliacus muscle.origin: Upper two-thirds of the iliac fossa
Iliacus muscle.insertion: Base of the lesser trochanter of femur
Iliacus muscle.blood: Medial femoral circumflex artery, iliac branch of iliolumbar artery

Iliocostalis.title: Iliocostalis
Iliocostalis.origin: Sacrum, iliac crest, thoracolumbar fascia, spinous processes of vertebrae from T11 - L5
Iliocostalis.action: Unilaterally: laterally flex the vertebral column to the same side. Bilaterally: Extend the vertebral column.

Inferior nasal concha.title: Inferior nasal concha
Inferior nasal concha.articulations: Ethmoid, maxilla, lacrimal and palatine bone

Inferior oblique muscle.title: Inferior oblique muscle
Inferior oblique muscle.origin: Orbital surface of the maxilla, lateral to the lacrimal groove
Inferior oblique muscle.insertion: Laterally onto the eyeball, deep to the lateral rectus, by a short flat tendon

Inferior pharyngeal constrictor muscle.title: Inferior pharyngeal constrictor muscle
Inferior pharyngeal constrictor muscle.nerve: Pharyngeal plexus of vagus nerve, recurrent laryngeal nerve and superior laryngeal nerve

Inferior rectus muscle.title: Inferior rectus muscle
Inferior rectus muscle.origin: Common tendinous ring at the orbital apex
Inferior rectus muscle.insertion: 6.8 mm inferior to the corneal limbus
Inferior rectus muscle.blood: Inferior muscular branch of the ophthalmic artery, infraorbital artery

Infraspinatus muscle.title: Infraspinatus muscle
Infraspinatus muscle.insertion: Middle facet of greater tubercle of the humerus
Infraspinatus muscle.action: External rotation of arm and stabilization of glenohumeral joint

Innermost intercostal muscle.title: Innermost intercostal muscle
Innermost intercostal muscle.action: Through adduction of upper ribs to the lower ribs the muscles narrow intercostal slits and diminish thorax volume, therefore the muscles represent expiratory muscles.

Internal obturator muscle.title: Internal obturator muscle
Internal obturator muscle.insertion: Medial aspect of the greater trochanter
Internal obturator muscle.action: Abducts and laterally rotates the extended hip and abducts the flexed thigh at the hip, and stabilizes the hip during walking
Internal obturator muscle.nerve: Nerve to obturator internus (L5, S1, S2)

Lateral pterygoid muscle.title: Lateral pterygoid muscle
Lateral pterygoid muscle.origin: Superior head: infratemporal surface of sphenoid bone. Inferior head: lateral pterygoid plate
Lateral pterygoid muscle.insertion: Superior head: anterior side of the mandibular condyle. Inferior head: pterygoid fovea
Lateral pterygoid muscle.action: Depresses and protrudes mandible, side to side movement of mandible
Lateral pterygoid muscle.nerve: Lateral pterygoid nerve from mandibular nerve

Lateral rectus muscle.title: Lateral rectus muscle
Lateral rectus muscle.origin: Common tendinous ring at the orbital apex
Lateral rectus muscle.action: Abducts the eyeball (makes it move outwards)

Latissimus dorsi muscle.title: Latissimus dorsi muscle
Latissimus dorsi muscle.origin: Spinous processes of vertebrae T7-S5, thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest, inferior 4 ribs and inferior angle of scapula
Latissimus dorsi muscle.insertion: Floor of intertubercular groove of the humerus
Latissimus dorsi muscle.action: Adducts, extends and internally rotates the arm when the insertion is moved towards the origin. When observing the muscle action of the origin towards the insertion, the lats are a very powerful rotator of the trunk.
Latissimus dorsi muscle.blood: Thoracodorsal branch of the subscapular artery

Levator labii superioris.title: Levator labii superioris
Levator labii superioris.insertion: Skin and muscle of the upper lip (labii superioris)
Levator labii superioris.nerve: Buccal branch of the facial nerve (C.N. VII)

Levator labii superioris alaeque nasi mu.title: Levator labii superioris alaeque nasi muscle
Levator labii superioris alaeque nasi mu.action: Dilates the nostril; elevates the upper lip and wing of the nose

Levator palpebrae superioris muscle.title: Levator palpebrae superioris muscle
Levator palpebrae superioris muscle.origin: Inferior surface of lesser wing of sphenoid
Levator palpebrae superioris muscle.insertion: Superior tarsal plate and skin of upper eyelid
Levator palpebrae superioris muscle.antagonist: Palpebral part of orbicularis oculi muscle
Levator palpebrae superioris muscle.blood: Muscular branches of ophthalmic artery and supraorbital artery

Levator scapulae muscle.title: Levator scapulae muscle
Levator scapulae muscle.origin: Posterior tubercles of transverse processes of C1 - C4 vertebrae
Levator scapulae muscle.insertion: Superior part of medial border of scapula
Levator scapulae muscle.action: Elevates scapula and tilts its glenoid cavity inferiorly by downwardly rotating the scapula
Levator scapulae muscle.nerve: Cervical nerve (C3, C4) and dorsal scapular nerve (C5)

Levatores costarum muscles.title: Levatores costarum muscles
Levatores costarum muscles.origin: Transverse processes of C7 to T11 vertebrae
Levatores costarum muscles.insertion: Superior surfaces of the ribs immediately inferior to the preceding vertebrae
Levatores costarum muscles.action: Assists in elevation of the thoracic rib cage

Longissimus.title: Longissimus
Longissimus.action: Laterally: Flex the head and neck to the same side. Bilaterally: Extend the vertebral column.

Longus capitis muscle.title: Longus capitis muscle
Longus capitis muscle.origin: Anterior tubercles of the transverse processes of the third, fourth, fifth, and sixth cervical vertebræ
Longus capitis muscle.insertion: Basilar part of the occipital bone
Longus capitis muscle.action: Flexion of neck at atlanto-occipital joint
Longus capitis muscle.blood: Added blood supply to infobox from Gray's Anatomy via Elsevier Complete Anatomy

Longus colli muscle.title: Longus colli muscle
Longus colli muscle.origin: Transverse processes of C5 to T3
Longus colli muscle.blood: Ascending pharyngeal artery and vertebral arteries

Lumbricals of the hand.title: Lumbricals of the hand
Lumbricals of the hand.action: Flex metacarpophalangeal joints, extend interphalangeal joints
Lumbricals of the hand.nerve: Third and fourth deep branch of ulnar nerve, first and second median nerve
Lumbricals of the hand.blood: Superficial palmar arch, common palmar digital arteries, deep palmar arch, dorsal digital artery

Lunate bone.title: Lunate bone
Lunate bone.articulations: Radius proximally, capitate and hamate distally, scaphoid laterally, triquetrum medially, triangular fibrocartilage

Masseter muscle.title: Masseter muscle
Masseter muscle.origin: Zygomatic arch and maxillary process of zygomatic bone
Masseter muscle.insertion: Angle surface of ramus of mandible, coronoid process
Masseter muscle.action: Elevation (as in closing of the mouth) and protrusion of mandible

Medial pterygoid muscle.title: Medial pterygoid muscle
Medial pterygoid muscle.origin: Deep head: medial side of lateral pterygoid plate behind the upper teeth, Superficial head: pyramidal process of palatine bone and maxillary tuberosity
Medial pterygoid muscle.action: Elevates mandible, closes jaw, helps lateral pterygoids in moving the jaw from side to side
Medial pterygoid muscle.nerve: Mandibular nerve via nerve to medial pterygoid

Medial rectus muscle.title: Medial rectus muscle
Medial rectus muscle.origin: Common tendinous ring at the orbital apex
Medial rectus muscle.action: Adducts the eyeball (makes it move inwards)
Medial rectus muscle.nerve: Inferior division of the oculomotor nerve

Mentalis.title: Mentalis
Mentalis.action: Elevates and wrinkles skin of chin, protrudes lower lip

Metatarsal bones.title: Metatarsal bones
Metatarsal bones.articulations: Proximal phalanges, medial cuneiform, intermediate cuneiform, lateral cuneiform and the cuboid bone.

Multifidus muscle.title: Multifidus muscle
Multifidus muscle.origin: Sacrum, erector spinae aponeurosis, PSIS, and iliac crest
Multifidus muscle.action: Provides proprioceptive feedback and input due to high muscle spindle density; Bilateral backward extension, unilateral ipsilateral side-bending and contralateral rotation.

Mylohyoid muscle.title: Mylohyoid muscle
Mylohyoid muscle.insertion: Body of hyoid bone and median ridge
Mylohyoid muscle.action: Raises oral cavity floor, elevates hyoid, elevates tongue, depresses mandible
Mylohyoid muscle.nerve: Mylohyoid nerve, from inferior alveolar branch of mandibular nerve
Mylohyoid muscle.blood: Mylohyoid branch of inferior alveolar artery and submental artery of facial artery

Nasalis muscle.title: Nasalis muscle
Nasalis muscle.action: Compresses bridge of nose, depresses tip of nose, elevates corners of nostrils
Nasalis muscle.nerve: Buccal branch of the facial nerve

Obliquus capitis superior muscle.title: Obliquus capitis superior muscle
Obliquus capitis superior muscle.insertion: Lateral half of the inferior nuchal line
Obliquus capitis superior muscle.action: Extends head and flex head to the ipsilateral side

Occipital bone.title: Occipital bone
Occipital bone.articulations: The two parietals, the two temporals, the sphenoid, and the atlas

Occipitalis muscle.title: Occipitalis muscle
Occipitalis muscle.origin: Superior nuchal line of the occipital bone and mastoid process of the temporal bone
Occipitalis muscle.nerve: Posterior auricular nerve (a branch of the facial nerve)

Omohyoid muscle.title: Omohyoid muscle
Omohyoid muscle.origin: Upper border of the scapula (inferior belly), intermediate tendon (superior belly)
Omohyoid muscle.insertion: Intermediate tendon (inferior belly), hyoid bone (superior belly)
Omohyoid muscle.action: Depresses the larynx and hyoid bone. Also carries hyoid bone backward and to the side.
Omohyoid muscle.blood: Branches from the inferior thyroid artery (ITA)

Opponens digiti minimi muscle of hand.title: Opponens digiti minimi muscle of hand
Opponens digiti minimi muscle of hand.origin: Hook of hamate and flexor retinaculum
Opponens digiti minimi muscle of hand.insertion: Medial border of 5th metacarpal (in hand, 3rd digit is orientation of mid-line)
Opponens digiti minimi muscle of hand.action: Draws 5th metacarpal anteriorly and rotates it, bringing little finger (5th digit) into opposition with thumb
Opponens digiti minimi muscle of hand.nerve: Deep branch of ulnar nerve (C8 and T1)

Opponens pollicis muscle.title: Opponens pollicis muscle
Opponens pollicis muscle.insertion: Metacarpal bone of the thumb on its radial side
Opponens pollicis muscle.action: Flexion of the thumb's metacarpal at the first carpometacarpal joint, which aids in opposition of the thumb
Opponens pollicis muscle.nerve: Recurrent branch of the median nerve

Orbicularis oculi muscle.title: Orbicularis oculi muscle
Orbicularis oculi muscle.origin: Frontal bone; medial palpebral ligament; lacrimal bone
Orbicularis oculi muscle.nerve: Temporal (orbital, palpebral) and zygomatic (lacrimal) branches of facial nerve

Orbicularis oris muscle.title: Orbicularis oris muscle
Orbicularis oris muscle.action: It is sometimes known as the kissing muscle because it is used to pucker the lips.
Orbicularis oris muscle.blood: Inferior labial artery and superior labial artery.

Palatopharyngeus muscle.title: Palatopharyngeus muscle
Palatopharyngeus muscle.insertion: Upper border of thyroid cartilage (blends with constrictor fibers)

Palmar interossei muscles.title: Palmar interossei muscles
Palmar interossei muscles.insertion: Bases of proximal phalanges, extensor expansions
Palmar interossei muscles.blood: Palmar metacarpal artery of deep palmar arch

Palmaris longus muscle.title: Palmaris longus muscle
Palmaris longus muscle.origin: Medial epicondyle of humerus (common flexor tendon)
Palmaris longus muscle.insertion: Palmar aponeurosis and flexor retinaculum of the hand
Palmaris longus muscle.antagonist: Extensor carpi radialis brevis, extensor carpi radialis longus, extensor carpi ulnaris

Parietal bone.title: Parietal bone
Parietal bone.articulations: Five bones: the opposite parietal, the occipital, the frontal, the temporal, and the sphenoid

Pectineus muscle.title: Pectineus muscle
Pectineus muscle.origin: Pectineal line of the pubic bone

Pectoralis major.title: Pectoralis major
Pectoralis major.origin: Clavicular head: anterior surface of the medial half of the clavicle., Sternocostal head: anterior surface of the sternum, the superior six costal cartilages, and the aponeurosis of the external oblique muscle
Pectoralis major.insertion: Lateral lip of the bicipital groove of the humerus, (anteromedial proximal humerus)
Pectoralis major.action: Clavicular head: flexes the humerus Sternocostal head: horizontal and vertical adduction, extension, and internal rotation of the humerus, Depression and abduction of the scapula.
Pectoralis major.nerve: Lateral pectoral nerve and medial pectoral nerve, Clavicular head: C5 and C6, Sternocostal head: C7, C8 and T1
Pectoralis major.blood: Pectoral branch of the thoracoacromial trunk

Pectoralis minor.title: Pectoralis minor
Pectoralis minor.origin: Third to fifth ribs, near the costochondral junction
Pectoralis minor.insertion: Medial border and superior surface of the coracoid process of the scapula
Pectoralis minor.action: Stabilizes the scapula by drawing it inferiorly and anteriorly against the thoracic wall, raises ribs in inhalation
Pectoralis minor.blood: Pectoral branch of the thoracoacromial trunk

Peroneus longus.title: Fibularis longus
Peroneus longus.origin: Proximal part of lateral surface of shaft of fibula and head of fibula

Piriformis muscle.title: Piriformis muscle
Piriformis muscle.nerve: Nerve to the piriformis (L5, S1, and S2)
Piriformis muscle.blood: Inferior gluteal, lateral sacral and superior gluteal artery

Plantaris muscle.title: Plantaris muscle
Plantaris muscle.origin: Lateral supracondylar ridge of femur above lateral head of gastrocnemius
Plantaris muscle.insertion: Tendo calcaneus (medial side, deep to gastrocnemius tendon)
Plantaris muscle.action: Plantar flexes foot and flexes knee
Plantaris muscle.nerve: Tibial nerve from anterior rami of S1-S2

Platysma muscle.title: Platysma muscle
Platysma muscle.origin: Subcutaneous tissue of infraclavicular and supraclavicular regions
Platysma muscle.insertion: Base of mandible; skin of cheek and lower lip; angle of mouth; orbicularis oris
Platysma muscle.action: Draws the corners of the mouth inferiorly and widens it (as in expressions of sadness and fright). Also draws the skin of the neck superiorly when teeth are clenched
Platysma muscle.nerve: Cervical branch of the facial nerve
Platysma muscle.blood: Branches of the submental artery and suprascapular artery

Popliteus muscle.title: Popliteus muscle
Popliteus muscle.insertion: Posterior surface of the tibia proximal to the soleus line
Popliteus muscle.action: Medially rotates tibia on the femur if the femur is fixed (sitting down) or laterally rotates femur on the tibia if tibia is fixed (standing up), unlocks the knee to allow flexion (bending), helps to prevent the forward dislocation of the femur while crouching

Procerus muscle.title: Procerus muscle
Procerus muscle.origin: From fascia over the lower part of the nasal bone
Procerus muscle.insertion: Into the skin of the lower part of the forehead between the eyebrows
Procerus muscle.action: Draws down the medial angle of the eyebrow giving expressions of frowning
Procerus muscle.nerve: Temporal branch of the facial nerve

Pronator quadratus muscle.title: Pronator quadratus muscle
Pronator quadratus muscle.origin: Medial, anterior surface of the ulna
Pronator quadratus muscle.insertion: Lateral, anterior surface of the radius

Psoas major muscle.title: Psoas major muscle
Psoas major muscle.origin: Transverse processes of T12–L4 and the lateral aspects of the discs between them
Psoas major muscle.insertion: In the lesser trochanter of the femur
Psoas major muscle.nerve: Lumbar plexus via anterior branches of L1–L3 nerves

Quadratus femoris muscle.title: Quadratus femoris muscle
Quadratus femoris muscle.action: Lateral rotation and adduction of thigh
Quadratus femoris muscle.blood: Inferior gluteal artery, medial circumflex femoral artery

Quadratus lumborum muscle.title: Quadratus lumborum muscle
Quadratus lumborum muscle.insertion: Inferior border of 12th rib and L1-L4
Quadratus lumborum muscle.action: Alone (unilateral), lateral flexion of vertebral column; Together (bilateral), depression of thoracic rib cage
Quadratus lumborum muscle.nerve: The twelfth thoracic and first through fourth ventral rami of lumbar nerves (T12, L1-L4)
Quadratus lumborum muscle.blood: Lumbar arteries, lumbar branch of iliolumbar artery

Quadriceps femoris muscle.title: Quadriceps
Quadriceps femoris muscle.origin: Combined rectus femoris and vastus muscles
Quadriceps femoris muscle.action: Knee extension; hip flexion (rectus femoris only)

Rectus abdominis muscle.title: Rectus abdominis muscle
Rectus abdominis muscle.insertion: Costal cartilages of ribs 5-7 xiphoid process of sternum
Rectus abdominis muscle.nerve: Segmentally by thoraco-abdominal nerves (T7 to T11) and subcostal (T12)

Rectus capitis posterior major muscle.title: Rectus capitis posterior major muscle
Rectus capitis posterior major muscle.insertion: Inferior nuchal line of the occipital bone
Rectus capitis posterior major muscle.action: Ipsilateral rotation of head and extension
Rectus capitis posterior major muscle.nerve: Dorsal ramus of C1 (suboccipital nerve), sub-occipital nerve

Rectus capitis posterior minor muscle.title: Rectus capitis posterior minor muscle
Rectus capitis posterior minor muscle.origin: Tubercle on the posterior arch of the atlas
Rectus capitis posterior minor muscle.insertion: Medial part of the inferior nuchal line of the occipital bone and the surface between it and the foramen magnum
Rectus capitis posterior minor muscle.action: Extends the head at the neck, but is now considered to be more of a sensory organ than a muscle
Rectus capitis posterior minor muscle.nerve: Branch of the dorsal primary division of the suboccipital nerve

Rhomboid major muscle.title: Rhomboid major muscle
Rhomboid major muscle.origin: Spinous processes of the T2 to T5 vertebrae
Rhomboid major muscle.insertion: Medial border of the scapula, inferior to the insertion of rhomboid minor muscle
Rhomboid major muscle.action: Retracts the scapula and rotates it to depress the glenoid cavity. It also fixes the scapula to the thoracic wall.

Rhomboid minor muscle.title: Rhomboid minor muscle
Rhomboid minor muscle.origin: Nuchal ligaments and spinous processes of C7-T1
Rhomboid minor muscle.insertion: Medial border of scapula, superior to the insertion of rhomboid major muscle
Rhomboid minor muscle.action: Retracts and rotates scapula, fixes scapula to thoracic wall
Rhomboid minor muscle.blood: Deep branch of transverse cervical artery

Risorius.title: Risorius
Risorius.nerve: Buccal branch of the facial nerve

Rotatores muscles.title: Rotatores muscles
Rotatores muscles.insertion: Junction of transverse process and lamina, spinous process

Sartorius muscle.title: Sartorius muscle
Sartorius muscle.origin: Anterior superior iliac spine of the pelvic bone
Sartorius muscle.insertion: Anteromedial surface of the proximal tibia in the pes anserinus
Sartorius muscle.action: Flexion, abduction, and lateral rotation of the hip, flexion of the knee
Sartorius muscle.nerve: Femoral nerve (sometimes from the intermediate cutaneous nerve of thigh)

Scalene muscles.title: Scalene muscles
Scalene muscles.action: Elevation of first and second ribs
Scalene muscles.blood: Ascending cervical artery, (branch of Inferior thyroid artery)

Scaphoid bone.title: Scaphoid bone
Scaphoid bone.articulations: Articulates with five bones, radius proximally, trapezoid bone and trapezium bone distally, capitate and lunate medially

Semimembranosus muscle.title: Semimembranosus muscle
Semimembranosus muscle.action: Extension of hip and flexion of knee
Semimembranosus muscle.nerve: Tibial part of sciatic nerve, (L5, S1 and S2)
Semimembranosus muscle.antagonist: Quadriceps muscle and tensor fasciae latae

Semitendinosus muscle.title: Semitendinosus muscle
Semitendinosus muscle.origin: Lower quadrangular part of tuberosity of the ischium
Semitendinosus muscle.action: Flexion of knee, extension of the hip joint

Serratus anterior muscle.title: Serratus anterior muscle
Serratus anterior muscle.origin: Fleshy slips from the outer surface of upper from 1st to 9 ribs
Serratus anterior muscle.insertion: Costal aspect of medial margin of the scapula
Serratus anterior muscle.action: Protracts and stabilizes scapula, assists in upward rotation, assists in inspiration (when shoulder girdle is fixed)
Serratus anterior muscle.nerve: Long thoracic nerve (from roots of brachial plexus C5-C7)
Serratus anterior muscle.blood: Lateral thoracic artery, superior thoracic artery (upper part), thoracodorsal artery (lower part)

Serratus posterior inferior muscle.title: Serratus posterior inferior muscle
Serratus posterior inferior muscle.origin: Vertebrae: Spinous processes of T11 - L2
Serratus posterior inferior muscle.insertion: The inferior borders of the 9th through 12th ribs
Serratus posterior inferior muscle.action: Depress the lower ribs 9-12, aiding in expiration

Serratus posterior superior muscle.title: Serratus posterior superior muscle
Serratus posterior superior muscle.origin: Nuchal ligament (or ligamentum nuchae) and the spinous processes of the vertebrae C7 through T3
Serratus posterior superior muscle.insertion: The upper borders of the 2nd through 5th ribs

Soleus muscle.title: Soleus muscle
Soleus muscle.origin: Fibula, medial border of tibia (soleal line)
Soleus muscle.nerve: Tibial nerve, specifically, nerve roots L5–S2
Soleus muscle.blood: Popliteal artery, posterior tibial artery, peroneal artery

Spinalis.title: Spinalis
Spinalis.origin: Thoracis: Spinous process of upper lumbar and lower thoracic vertebrae., Cervicis: nuchal ligament and spinous process of C7.
Spinalis.insertion: Thoracis: Spinous process of upper thoracic vertebrae., Cervicis: Spinous process of cervical vertebrae except atlas.
Spinalis.action: Laterally: Flex the head and neck to the same side. Bilaterally: Extend the vertebral column.

Splenius capitis muscle.title: Splenius capitis muscle
Splenius capitis muscle.origin: Nuchal ligament and spinous process of C7-T3
Splenius capitis muscle.insertion: Mastoid process of temporal and occipital bone
Splenius capitis muscle.action: Extend, rotate, and laterally flex the head
Splenius capitis muscle.nerve: Posterior ramus of spinal nerves C3 and C4

Splenius cervicis muscle.title: Splenius cervicis muscle
Splenius cervicis muscle.action: Bilaterally: Extend the head and neck, Unilaterally: Lateral flexion to the same side, Rotation to the same side.
Splenius cervicis muscle.nerve: Posterior rami of the lower Cervical spinal nerves
Splenius cervicis muscle.blood: Transverse cervical artery and occipital artery

Sternocleidomastoid muscle.title: Sternocleidomastoid muscle
Sternocleidomastoid muscle.origin: Manubrium and medial portion of the clavicle
Sternocleidomastoid muscle.insertion: Mastoid process of the temporal bone, superior nuchal line
Sternocleidomastoid muscle.action: Unilaterally: contralateral cervical rotation, ipsilateral cervical flexion Bilaterally: cervical flexion, elevation of sternum and assists in forced inhalation.
Sternocleidomastoid muscle.nerve: Motor: spinal accessory nerve, sensory: cervical plexus, Proprioceptive: ventral primary rami of C2 and C3
Sternocleidomastoid muscle.blood: Occipital artery and the superior thyroid artery

Sternohyoid muscle.title: Sternohyoid muscle
Sternohyoid muscle.nerve: C1-C3 by a branch of ansa cervicalis

Stylopharyngeus muscle.title: Stylopharyngeus muscle
Stylopharyngeus muscle.action: Elevates the larynx, elevates the pharynx, dilates the pharynx; facilitates swallowing

Subclavius muscle.title: Subclavius muscle
Subclavius muscle.insertion: Subclavian groove of clavicle (inferior surface of middle one third of the clavicle)
Subclavius muscle.action: Depression of clavicle, elevation of first rib

Subscapularis muscle.title: Subscapularis muscle
Subscapularis muscle.action: Internally rotates and adducts humerus; stabilizes shoulder
Subscapularis muscle.nerve: Upper subscapular nerve, lower subscapular nerve (C5, C6)

Superior oblique muscle.title: Superior oblique muscle
Superior oblique muscle.origin: Sphenoid bone at the orbital apex, medial to optic canal
Superior oblique muscle.insertion: Outer posterior quadrant of the eyeball
Superior oblique muscle.action: Primary action is intorsion (medial rotation); secondary actions are to abduct and depress the eyeball (i.e. it makes the eye move outward and downward)
Superior oblique muscle.blood: Lateral muscular branch of the ophthalmic artery

Superior pharyngeal constrictor muscle.title: Superior pharyngeal constrictor muscle
Superior pharyngeal constrictor muscle.origin: Medial pterygoid plate, pterygomandibular raphé, alveolar process
Superior pharyngeal constrictor muscle.blood: Ascending pharyngeal artery and tonsillar branch of facial artery

Superior rectus muscle.title: Superior rectus muscle
Superior rectus muscle.origin: Annulus of Zinn at the orbital apex
Superior rectus muscle.insertion: 7.9 mm superior to the corneal limbus

Supinator muscle.title: Supinator muscle
Supinator muscle.origin: Lateral epicondyle of humerus, supinator crest of ulna, radial collateral ligament, annular ligament
Supinator muscle.nerve: Deep branch of the radial nerve

Supraspinatus muscle.title: Supraspinatus muscle
Supraspinatus muscle.insertion: Superior facet of greater tubercle of humerus
Supraspinatus muscle.action: Abduction of arm and stabilizes humerus

Temporal bone.title: Temporal bone
Temporal bone.articulations: Occipital, parietal, sphenoid, mandible and zygomatic

Temporal muscle.title: Temporalis muscle
Temporal muscle.origin: Temporal lines on the parietal bone of the skull and the superior temporal surface of the sphenoid bone
Temporal muscle.insertion: Coronoid process of the mandible and retromolar fossa
Temporal muscle.nerve: Deep temporal nerves, branches of the anterior division of the mandibular nerve (V3)

Temporoparietalis muscle.title: Temporoparietalis muscle
Temporoparietalis muscle.nerve: Temporal branches of the facial nerve

Teres major muscle.title: Teres major muscle
Teres major muscle.origin: Posterior aspect of the inferior angle of the scapula
Teres major muscle.insertion: Medial lip of the intertubercular sulcus of the humerus
Teres major muscle.action: Adduct the humerus, internal rotation (medial rotation) of the humerus, extend the humerus from flexed position
Teres major muscle.nerve: Lower subscapular nerve (segmental levels C5 and C6)

Teres minor muscle.title: Teres minor muscle
Teres minor muscle.insertion: Inferior facet of greater tubercle of the humerus
Teres minor muscle.action: Laterally rotates the arm, stabilizes humerus
Teres minor muscle.blood: Posterior circumflex humeral artery and the circumflex scapular artery

Thoracic diaphragm.title: Thoracic diaphragm
Thoracic diaphragm.origin: L1–L3, the xiphoid process, 6–12th rib and their costal cartilages
Thoracic diaphragm.blood: Pericardiacophrenic artery, musculophrenic artery, inferior phrenic arteries

Thyrohyoid muscle.title: Thyrohyoid muscle
Thyrohyoid muscle.action: Elevates thyroid and depresses the hyoid bone
Thyrohyoid muscle.nerve: First cervical nerve (C1) via hypoglossal nerve

Tibia.title: Tibia
Tibia.articulations: Knee, ankle, superior and, inferior tibiofibular joint

Tibialis anterior muscle.title: Tibialis anterior muscle
Tibialis anterior muscle.origin: From the upper 1/2 or 2/3 of the lateral surface of the tibia and the adjacent interosseous membrane
Tibialis anterior muscle.insertion: Medial cuneiform and the base of first metatarsal bone of the foot
Tibialis anterior muscle.action: Dorsiflexion and inversion of the foot
Tibialis anterior muscle.antagonist: Fibularis longus, gastrocnemius, soleus, plantaris, tibialis posterior

Tibialis posterior muscle.title: Tibialis posterior muscle
Tibialis posterior muscle.action: Inversion of the foot and plantar flexion of the foot at the ankle
Tibialis posterior muscle.antagonist: Fibularis brevis and longus, antagonist to the inversion

Transverse abdominal muscle.title: Transverse abdominal muscle
Transverse abdominal muscle.origin: Iliac crest, inguinal ligament, thoracolumbar fascia, and costal cartilages 7-12
Transverse abdominal muscle.insertion: Xiphoid process, linea alba, pubic crest and pecten pubis via conjoint tendon
Transverse abdominal muscle.action: Compresses abdominal contents (bilateral), rotates trunk ipsilaterally (unilateral)
Transverse abdominal muscle.nerve: Thoracoabdominal nn. (T6-T11), Subcostal n. (T12), iliohypogastric nerve (L1), and ilioinguinal nerve (L1)

Transversus thoracis muscle.title: Transversus thoracis muscle
Transversus thoracis muscle.origin: Costal cartilages of last 3-4 true ribs, body of sternum and xiphoid process

Trapezium (bone).title: Trapezium (bone)
Trapezium (bone).articulations: 1st metacarpal distally, scaphoid proximally, trapezoid medially, 2nd metacarpal medially

Trapezius.title: Trapezius
Trapezius.origin: Medial one-third of superior nuchal line, external occipital protuberance, spinous processes of vertebrae C7-T12, Nuchal ligament
Trapezius.insertion: Posterior border of the lateral one-third of the clavicle, acromion process, and spine of scapula
Trapezius.action: Rotation, retraction, elevation, and depression of scapula
Trapezius.nerve: Accessory nerve (motor), cervical spinal nerves C3 and C4 (motor and sensation)
Trapezius.antagonist: Serratus anterior muscle, latissimus dorsi, pectoralis major
Trapezius.blood: Superficial branch of transverse cervical artery or superficial cervical artery

Trapezoid bone.title: Trapezoid bone
Trapezoid bone.articulations: Articulates with four bones:, scaphoid proximally, second metacarpal distally, trapezium bone laterally, capitate medially

Triceps.title: Triceps
Triceps.origin: Long head: infraglenoid tubercle of scapula, Lateral head: above the radial groove, Medial head: below the radial groove
Triceps.action: Extends forearm, long head extends, adducts arm, extends shoulder
Triceps.blood: Deep brachial artery, posterior circumflex humeral artery (long head only)

Triquetral bone.title: Triquetral bone
Triquetral bone.articulations: Articulates with three bones:, lunate laterally, pisiform in front, hamate distally, triangular articular disk which separates it from the lower end of the ulna.

Zygomatic bone.title: Zygomatic bone
Zygomatic bone.articulations: Maxilla, temporal bone, sphenoid bone and frontal bone

Zygomaticus major muscle.title: Zygomaticus major muscle
Zygomaticus major muscle.action: Draws the angle of the mouth upward laterally
Zygomaticus major muscle.nerve: Zygomatic and buccal branches of the facial nerve
